notes_for_questioner: Caveats worth a line in the post: (1) archive 12m-only continuum at 10 arcsec may miss extended dust emission (Band 6/7 maximum recoverable scale), so the 5-8 mK envelope Tb is a lower limit; a check against single-dish/Herschel-based global dust Tb (Td 30 K, tau small) would bound it. (2) The envelope being hot-or-warm remains unresolved: needs an independent temperature tracer (CH3CCH, H13CN, high-J CO). Consider asking whether the 1-0 data (free-free extrapolation) drive Q22 results, and whether IR pumping matters for the cores.
